title: brigade-citrine
body:
Brigade Citrine is a pioneering residential project from Brigade Group, located at Budigere Cross near Old Madras Road, North Bangalore. Spanning 4.2 acres, this premium development features 420 elegantly designed 1, 2, 3, and 4 BHK apartments across two striking towers of 30 floors each. As India’s first net-zero carbon residential project, Brigade Citrine sets a new benchmark for sustainable, future-ready living, blending modern architecture with eco-conscious innovation.
Exemplary Design & Amenities

    2 Towers | G+30 Floors | 420 Premium Apartments
    Spread over 4.2 acres with 80% open spaces and lush landscaping.
    Net-zero carbon design: renewable energy, rainwater harvesting, energy-efficient systems, and up to 300 tonnes of waste diverted from landfill annually.
    Up to 46.5% reduction in water demand from external sources.
    Possession: June 2029
    RERA No.: PRM/KA/RERA/1250/304/PR/131224/007287

Amenities that Elevate Everyday Living:

Sports & Fitness:

    Jogging / Cycle Track
    Yoga Areas
    Multy Play Court
    Outside fitness Area

Community Spaces:

    Party Hall
    Indoor Games Room
    Senior Citizen Area
    Club House
    Landscaped Gardens

Safety Features:

    24 x 7 Security
    CCTV / Video Surveillance
    EV Charging
    Car Parking

Prime Location – Budigere Cross, Bangalore

    Strategically located on Old Madras Road, with seamless access to Whitefield, KR Puram, ITPL, and Marathahalli.
    2.3 km from Bearys Global Research Triangle
    10 km from ITPL and ITPB, 14.4 km from EPIP Zone, and 15.3 km from Bagmane Tech Park
    18 km from KIADB Industrial Area

Proximity to top Education Institutions:

    VIBGYOR High School
    Garden City University
    One World International School
    Orchids International School

Nearby Hospitals:

    East Point Hospital
    KR Puram Hospital
    Manipal Hospital
    Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences

Upcoming Infrastructure Development

    Peripheral Ring Road (PRR): Will connect Old Madras Road to Hosur and Tumkur Roads, boosting connectivity and expected to increase property values by 20–30% upon completion.

    Kempegowda International Airport (KIA) Access Road: This direct access road to Kempegowda International Airport will significantly reduce travel time, enhancing the area appeal for frequent flyers, professionals, and business travelers.

    Bangalore Suburban Railway Corridor: A proposed station at Huskur will provide seamless connectivity to central Bengaluru, making daily commutes easier.

    Namma Metro Phase 2 and NH-75 upgrades: Further improving accessibility and driving real estate growth in the area.

Top Reasons to Invest in Brigade Citrine, Budigere Cross

    India’s first net-zero carbon residential project, meeting LEED/BREEAM green building standards.

    Proximity to major IT hubs like Whitefield and ORR drives strong rental demand and appreciation

    Upcoming infrastructure (Metro, PRR, NH-75) set to boost connectivity and property demand

    Developed by Brigade Group, a trusted brand with a proven track record.

Brigade Citrine is more than just a home—it’s a sustainable lifestyle. With its net-zero carbon design, prime location, and robust growth prospects, this project is an ideal choice for eco-conscious homebuyers and savvy investors alike.
About Brigade Group

Founded in 1986 by M.R. Jaishankar Brigade Group is one of South India most trusted real estate brands. With 80+ million sq. ft. of developed space across residential, commercial, hospitality, and education segments, the group is known for iconic projects like Orion Mall, World Trade Center, and multiple integrated townships.

    Top Builder – India at CWAB Awards 2022
    Integrated Township of the Year – Realty+ Awards 2019
    Realty Personality of the Year – ET Real Estate Awards 2022.

Conclusion

Brigade Citrine is more than just a home—it’s a sustainable lifestyle. With its net-zero carbon design, prime location, and robust growth prospects, this project is an ideal choice for eco-conscious homebuyers and savvy investors alike.
